issues.detail: The Hebrew 'רְגָלִים' (regalim) means 'festivals' or 'pilgrimage festivals' (from the root רגל, 'to go on foot' or 'to celebrate a festival'), not '腳掌' (soles of the feet). The Chinese rendering '三次腳掌的節期' incorrectly translates 'רְגָלִים' as 'feet/soles' instead of 'festivals/pilgrimages', changing the meaning from 'three festivals' to 'three festivals of the soles of the feet'.
